title: Stormrider island
summary: Break the stormrider formations and identify Pherlondien Clawpike among his copies.
overview: Break the stormrider formations and identify Pherlondien Clawpike among his copies.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Clear the twenty-seven designated island creatures to summon the Priest of Destruction and eight protected stormriders.
The priest activates two stormriders at a time, beginning shortly after engagement and then every thirty seconds. Secure each pair as it becomes active.
After the priest, defeat three sporadic stormriders to trigger the final formation.
Pherlondien appears at a randomized position among four false copies. The cooldown state can instead produce a loathesome stormclaw.
The final named opponent can clear hate; keep tanks ready while identifying and finishing the real target.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
